note: AFU 2019, optimising bladder cancer management in older patients. The most operational of the three: resection complications, instillation therapy, and what a cystectomy costs an older patient. Superseded for treatment decisions by AFU 2024-2026; what it carries is the geriatric adaptation.

default.note: Method, resection complications and perioperative management apply to any bladder tumour being resected, whatever its stage.

rules.note: MUST precede the BCG rule. The conversion filed `Cystectomie totale chez le sujet âgé` beneath `BCG-thérapie`, so a rule naming BCG claims the cystectomy sections too -- and cystectomy in an older patient is the question dossier 2 turns on.
